findings.title: EXIF GPS Spoofing Vulnerability (Hardware Telemetry Trust)
findings.description: The GPS geodesic matrix accurately calculates distances on the WGS-84 ellipsoid, but assumes EXIF metadata is unforgeable. An adversary with ExifTool can inject arbitrary coordinates matching the claimed site.
findings.impact: GPS mismatch detector (+35 pts) can be bypassed if the contractor deliberately forges EXIF coordinates.
findings.mitigation: Cross-correlate EXIF GPS with satellite optical ground truth and NOAA solar azimuth shadows to confirm geographic reality.

findings.title: Vulnerability to Arbitrary Rotational Transforms (45°/90°)
findings.description: While horizontal mirroring is fully defeated via the mirrored ensemble check, arbitrary 45-degree or 90-degree rotations disrupt DCT frequency coefficients, raising Hamming distance > 5.
findings.impact: A contractor rotating an old photograph by 90 degrees can evade pHash duplicate detection.
findings.mitigation: Extend the ensemble hash to evaluate 90°, 180°, and 270° orthogonal rotational variants.

findings.matrix: Verhoeff D5 Dihedral Aadhaar & Wage Matrix
findings.title: Synthetic Aadhaar IDs with Valid Verhoeff Dihedral Checksums
findings.description: The Verhoeff matrix detects 100% of single substitutions and transpositions, but cannot verify if a mathematically valid 12-digit number corresponds to a living citizen registered with UIDAI.
findings.impact: Sophisticated syndicates using mathematical Verhoeff generators can bypass checksum checks.
findings.mitigation: Combine Verhoeff validation with UIDAI API e-KYC gateway connector in live production.

findings.title: False Penalty (+10 pts) on Legitimate Compressed Uploads
findings.description: Uploading images through certain messaging platforms (e.g. WhatsApp) strips EXIF tags, automatically triggering the +10 pt unverifiable GPS penalty.
findings.impact: Legitimate rural citizens submitting social audit evidence may receive a 10-point penalty.
findings.mitigation: Prompt users to upload original uncompressed camera files or capture directly via web camera API.

findings.title: Localized Microclimate Precipitation Discrepancy
findings.description: Open-Meteo historical grid cells cover 10km x 10km. A localized thunderstorm may occur at the project site while the grid average records 0mm rainfall.
findings.impact: Potential false penalty (+15 pts) during localized monsoon micro-bursts.
findings.mitigation: Incorporate a 3-hour temporal tolerance window around claimed milestone timestamp.

findings.title: Temporary Surface Mud/Water Inundation Over Finished Pavement
findings.description: If a recently completed asphalt road is covered in floodwater or muddy tire tracks from nearby agricultural haulage, the optical detector may flag unpaved mud.
findings.impact: Authentic finished worksites could trigger a +25 pt material mismatch penalty.
findings.mitigation: Utilize Gemini 2.0 Flash contextual reasoning to differentiate surface mud layers from underlying asphalt base.
